description:
What do you notice on this play? Look again.

Most people see the quarterback get the first down. Some see him take it all the way for the touchdown. But almost nobody is watching the linemen who made sure he had somewhere to run in the first place.

That’s how we’ve been trained to look at success. We celebrate the person holding the ball and overlook the people creating the space.

That’s why we wrote “We Is Greater Than Me”Because behind almost every individual win is a collective effort nobody sees.

New book: “We Is Greater Than Me”
Preorders are live comment “Book” for the link
